why: Forbid-only: an empty policy set allows everything, so a loader that finds fewer ids than this has a silent permit, not a partial policy. `ids` are the same ids guidance.json renders and the Rego and CEL twins report. `assembly_tiers` names the one extra forbid per tier, annotated @assembly and carrying no @id, which fires when the tier's inputs were incomplete. A loader must find one forbid per id AND one per assembly tier.
